title: Sound Cylinder Match
shareTitle: Sound Cylinder Match — Find the Sound Twin
description: Listen to one coral mystery shaker, then test three visually identical aqua shakers to find its sound twin. A gentle kawaii auditory-discrimination game for ages 2–5.
learningGoals: Hear whether two sounds are the same or different
Hold one sound in short-term auditory memory
Match by sound rather than by color or markings
interactionModel: one-tap auditory comparison: replay one reference shaker, then tap one of three visually identical candidates
feedbackModel: A correct twin hops and glows with a recorded cheer; a different sound gently wobbles, replays the reference, and invites another listen without loss or failure.

modes.title: Find the Twin
modes.skill: auditory discrimination and short-term auditory memory
